summary: Retest of the follow-ups from iteration_crm_mod_contracts_locations_jan2026 as craig.henshall (CRM manager), plus a temporary sales_rep CRM user. 4 of 5 action items work. (1) The location role gate works: sales_rep gets 403 on POST, PUT and DELETE of locations. (2) The new location rename and remove work in the API and the UI: rename updates the name, remove archives the location, a location with equipment returns 409, an unknown id returns 404, and a blank name returns 400. In the UI, Rename shows on real locations and Remove only on empty ones. (3) totals.sites now counts real locations only (UI showed SITES 3 = Main Gym + Fitness Suite + a new TEST location). (4) ModContractsTab.remove now has try/catch with an error message, and the Email label shows '*' (both checked in the code). (5) NOT FIXED: MOD contracts still come back from GET /api/crm/v2/contracts and from the Live compliance feed. Backend: 7/8 new tests pass, and the earlier suite still passes 12/12 (1 skip).

minor.issue: The fix was made in routes/crm_contracts.py:177, but that handler never runs. routes/crm_v2.py:2589 registers the same path (/crm/v2/contracts) earlier and has no contract_type filter, so it wins. Reproduced: create an active MOD contract and GET /crm/v2/contracts returns it (contract_type='mod').
Not filtered (crm_aftersales.py:2664). Active MOD contracts still appear in the Live compliance feed. /contracts/stats and /contracts/expiring (crm_contracts.py) also still include MOD contracts.

No duplicate-name check on rename. You can rename a location to the name of an existing one and end up with two locations with the same name. Add uses a case-insensitive dedupe, so rename should match it.
You can archive any empty site in the linked org, including its primary or only site. There is no confirm in the UI either (Remove runs at once).

issues: Rename uses window.prompt. Remove has no confirmation. Both are inconsistent with the app's modal style.

action_items: Add the contract_type != 'mod' filter to the list_contracts handler that actually runs, in routes/crm_v2.py:2589 (or remove the duplicate route). The edit in crm_contracts.py:177 has no effect because that route is shadowed.
Add the same filter to GET /crm/v2/aftersales/contracts/compliance (crm_aftersales.py ~2664), and to /contracts/stats and /contracts/expiring if MOD contracts should be kept out of those as well
Optional: dedupe check on location rename; confirm before Remove; consider blocking archive of the org's primary site
